Tourists rent jet skis. Locals spin basket boats.

The basket boat tour at Dynasty Phu Quoc is one of those activities most visitors scroll past. 4.8 stars across 362 reviews says they're wrong to.

You paddle a round woven boat through calm water, then hand the oars to a local who makes it spin like a top. It's chaotic, wet, and genuinely fun.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
